newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Unilever declines comment on ICI talk.
newsitem.headline: Unilever declines comment on ICI talk.

text.p: Unilever NV /Plc on Wednesday declined to comment on a newspaper report that it was poised to announce the sale of its speciality chemicals unit to Britain's Imperial Chemical Industries Plc.
"At this stage we cannot say anything," a Unilever spokesman in Rotterdam said.
The European edition of the Wall Street Journal on Wednesday said Unilever and ICI were scheduled to announce a transaction on Wednesday, adding ICI may pay $8 billion for the chemicals interests.

Unilever's speciality chemicals business was put up for sale in February, prompting speculation that a number of firms, including ICI, might be interested. In April a British newspaper speculated ICI might pay four billion stg for the division.
